title: Commissions
content: Welcome to the commissions listing. Here I post updates of each commission I am working on for anyone interested in seeing the process. 🔒s denote clients who wished to remain anonymous. Progress updates on these pages are more limited to avoid identifying the clients. (I.e. WIP images of only parts of a 3D model, placeholder fur colors instead of the real thing, etc..) Clients: you can peek here for progress updates but please wait to provide review comments until I email you asking for review; more efficient that way.
